title.en: Make Everyday levels and speech speed explicit
title.zh: 明确显示生活口语等级与语速

purpose.en: Close the final Everyday acceptance gap: Intermediate and Advanced links preserved their URL level, but the player did not identify the selected level and opened with the same Beginner vocabulary; normal and slow playback settings also lacked an observable status.
purpose.zh: 修复最后一项生活口语验收缺口：中级、高级链接虽保留 URL 等级，但播放器未标识所选等级且仍以相同初级词汇开场；正常与慢速播放也缺少可观察状态。

en: Show Beginner, Intermediate, or Advanced in the player heading and every slide's progress label.
Start each level with visibly distinct, level-labelled scenario vocabulary while retaining ten paired conversations per place and level.
Expose the selected normal 0.84× or genuinely slow 0.42× speech setting with aria-pressed controls and a live status.
zh: 在播放器标题和每张幻灯片进度中显示初级、中级或高级。
每个等级从明显不同且带等级标签的场景词汇开始，同时保留每个地点、每个等级十组一问一答。
使用 aria-pressed 控件及实时状态显示正常 0.84× 或真正慢速 0.42× 语速设置。

en: Everyday Speaking presentation and prebuilt vocabulary ordering for all twelve languages and twelve places; no Clerk, payment, administrator, sibling-site, microphone, or database schema behavior.
zh: 十二种语言、十二个地点的生活口语展示与预构建词汇顺序；不影响 Clerk、支付、管理员、兄弟站点、麦克风或数据库结构。

en: Derive a bilingual visible level name from the selected route level and render it in the player.
Rotate scenario vocabulary by level and label each vocabulary stage with its level objective.
Add exact effective speed status and regression coverage for all levels, languages, and speed controls.
zh: 从所选路由等级生成双语可见等级名称并显示在播放器中。
按等级轮换场景词汇，并以等级目标标注每个词汇阶段。
增加精确有效语速状态，以及覆盖全部等级、语言和语速控件的回归测试。

en: Run the Everyday level/speed contracts, TypeScript, the complete automated suite, D1 migration validation, sensitive-data scan, production-equivalent build, changed-file lint, and shared portfolio gates.

Deploy only through GitHub Actions to Cloudflare, then use the ordinary test learner to open English airport Beginner, Intermediate, and Advanced and verify distinct visible level/data plus the normal/slow state transition.
zh: 执行生活口语等级/语速合同、TypeScript、全量自动化、D1 迁移、敏感数据扫描、生产等价构建、修改文件 lint 与共享组合门禁。
仅通过 GitHub Actions 发布到 Cloudflare，再由普通测试学员打开英语机场初、中、高三级，并验证不同可见等级/数据以及正常与慢速状态切换。

en: The final bilingual Project QA report requires a fresh Terra production retest of the three Everyday levels and observable speed state after this deployment.
zh: 最终双语 Project QA 报告需要 Terra 在本次发布后复测生活口语三级及可观察语速状态。

en: Preserve SmartLingo's existing database authority, Repeat After Me default-off behavior, GitHub-to-Cloudflare delivery, and SmartLingo-only data boundaries.
Do not modify any other site, account, credential, payment rail, database binding, or cloud resource.
zh: 保持 SmartLingo 既有数据库权威、跟读默认关闭、GitHub 至 Cloudflare 发布及仅限 SmartLingo 的数据边界。
不修改其他站点、账户、凭据、支付通道、数据库绑定或云资源。
